name: GeoDan Tools
description: Debug tools for GeoDan: hitbox overlay, hitbox trail and trajectory preview. Diagnostic only; never changes collision or physics.

show-hitboxes.name: Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draw each object's own hitbox outline during gameplay.

show-unclassified.name: Unclassified objects
show-unclassified.description: Also draw objects GeoDan cannot classify, in magenta.

show-hitbox-trail.name: Hitbox trail
show-hitbox-trail.description: Draw the player's recent hitboxes as a faded grey trail.

show-trajectory.name: Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Predict the player's path ahead, hold and release.
